description: Why an item's demand moved: its last 4 complete weeks of units against the expectation set by the 12 weeks before (direction down / up / flat, or insufficient_data), the weekly series with the same weeks last year, and the reasons Spark's own data supports — each with a category (seasonality, evidence, calendar, price_change, anomaly, stockout), a claim with its numbers, its source and a confidence (high / medium / low). Sources are this workspace's sales history and seasonal shape, submitted demand evidence, demand-calendar events, US retail dates, list-price history, stock-outs and detected demand anomalies; no external market data. dataNotes says what the data could not support. Present only the reasons returned, with their confidence; never add a cause the response does not carry. Read-only.
name: explain_demand_change
title: Explain Demand Change
